notes.title: Developer Live Stream
notes.content:
It's the Steam Autumn Games Festival, so it's time to show some un-released game play!

Stream Starts - Saturday at 8:30PM EST.

-Get a glimpse of some un-released content and learn more about the game.

-Ask questions and suggest ideas directly to the developer.

-Watch some speed running!

Hope to see you there :)

[previewyoutube=Gud_-HCsWbY;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Developer Live Stream
notes.content:
Come hang out and watch the developer play Vault: Tomb of the King for the Steam Games Festival!

Steam stream starts on Saturday June 20 at 8:30PM EST.

- Get a glimpse of some un-seen content and learn more about the game.

- Ask questions, suggest ideas and get behind the scenes information.

- Give him a hard time as he dies over and over.

Hope to see you there!

[previewyoutube=Gud_-HCsWbY;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Vault Discord AMA
notes.content:
As part of the Steam Games Festival, the developer will be available on Discord to answer any and all questions you have!

Join us on Discord([url=https://discord.gg/qK68vBq]https://discord.gg/qK68vBq[/url]) - June 16 at 8:30PM EST. 

- Come discuss the free demo, the full game and future plans.

- Suggest your ideas and be a part of the development process.

- Get to know an indie developer and make some new friends.

[url=https://discord.gg/qK68vBq][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37222605/daded44925f4e248595cff57d2a23833f31c5092.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Join the VAULT Discord
notes.content:
[b]Vault: Tomb of the King has a Discord! [/b]

Click the invitation and join us to talk about Vault and anything else!

[url=https://discord.gg/qK68vBq][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37222605/daded44925f4e248595cff57d2a23833f31c5092.png[/img][/url]

[b]Here are the Top 3 best reasons to join:[/b]

1) Speak directly to the developer and contribute your ideas to the full game.

2) Get first access to beta testing and early access builds of Vault!

3) Be part of a growing community that enjoys talking about anything and everything.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37222605/1d7f161dbfcbd05e5a266ce4fb9247df619c8d2e.png[/img]

Hope to see you soon...
